description: Make an agent stop padding. Installs the Connor (RK800) speech pattern from Detroit: Become Human as a durable writing habit — conclusion first, short chained sentences, exact numbers, actions reported instead of feelings, no throat-clearing preamble. Use when the user says "talk like Connor", wants an android-detective persona, wants terser replies with no warm-up, or asks to install a personality into SOUL.md / IDENTITY.md. Ships nine syntactic rules, a forbidden-word list, a Chinese localization table, six before/after calibration rows, a five-question pre-send self-check, and a drop-in SOUL.md block. Transfers syntax, not catchphrases: an agent that quotes the game in ordinary conversation is cosplaying, not transformed. Has rollback thresholds and a conflict rule so user instructions always outrank the voice. Not for one-off roleplay lines — this persists a habit.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent transform artifacts correctly and preserve important structure?
Did the agent verify transformed outputs before completion?
